failures.criterion: A3. Full-delivery replays, 3 runs each, no run reports the goal or a requirement as unmet.
failures.evidence: Not passed: its corpus still holds a case that is not a full delivery, and the replacement has not run. INFRA-110 is disproven, and I reproduced it myself rather than taking the ruling: at INFRA-110's approved head 454945e387c48579a0c64685b9ef1644240960f4 I built the 'moved file' tree its own spec names — the declaration `maxInputChars = 32000` left inside a `/* moved to limits.go: … */` block in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/embed/embed.go, and a live `const maxInputChars int = 8000` in a new embed/limits.go — and `bash .github/scripts/check-body-embed-limit.sh` printed `body limit 32000 (…dispatch-tools.ts:213) fits the embedder's 32000 (…embed.go:49)` and exited 0. The cause is `declaration()` at :96-122, which matches its pattern against every line of the file and knows nothing of comments. So the three INFRA-110 runs that flagged acceptance 1 were right and the case must go. Its replacement, INFRA-272, is a full delivery by an adversarial check that ran the code: fourteen built cases against packages/daemon/internal/classify at 2bfa2d3c, none of which broke it, with a negative control that reverts the guard to main's `if !ok {` and turns three tests red with `green`. The check is posted at dispatch://INFRA-904/comment/e45bd492-caa2-49d6-9897-08b41c6f4efb, with INFRA-225's (also a full delivery, kept behind INFRA-272 because its one child invites a 'pending, carried by the child' answer). INFRA-272's three replay runs have not been made. INFRA-158 is 3/3 and INFRA-87 is 3/3 on the bar as written: its run 2 marks 'Plan v2 Task 6' unmet, which I checked and found true in fact — cluster-grants/README.md:410-411 at the approved head still says the test covers 'every rule of legion/'s daemon Role' while cluster-grants/main_test.go:181-184 was widened to both Roles — but a plan task is not a requirement of the spec, and INFRA-87's acceptance 5 names five passages of which that README is none. The scorer counted it because it reads any `unmet` line of the block; it must count only the goal and the requirement rows.

failures.criterion: A6. The plan check on INFRA-184's spec at version 4, the as-written variant: rejected in every run, naming the goal.
failures.evidence: 0 of 3 after the re-cut: every change-arm run approves the plan (A6-INFRA-184.as-written-change-1, -2 and -3 all answer `approved`), where round 1 was 2 of 3 with a fixture that leaked later spec versions. The control is 1 of 3 rejected, so the change arm is now below its own control on this variant. The architect's reading is that the plan declares the shortfall in its own text ('The Goal … reaches a fourth text the Requirements do not name … This plan builds R1, R2 and R3 only') and that a plan which admits it leaves out goal-covered work must be rejected, with one more sharpening of the plan-reviewer stance allowed inside its word budget. The narrowed variant holds at 3/3 (control 2/3), so the plan check does reject a narrowed requirement.
